ui.cfg_b_traffic: History of downloads, visits and clones (read only)
cfg.f.traffic.enabled: Keep a history of downloads and traffic
cfg.h.traffic.enabled: Once a day reads the download counts of the release files, and the visits and clones, of the repositories you choose, and keeps them on this computer. GET requests only; nothing leaves the computer. Download counts are anonymous, include robots and do not count the "Source code" archives. Off by default.
cfg.h.traffic.repos: One per line: name (of the account you watch) or owner/name. Empty: nothing is read. At most 50.
cfg.h.traffic.views_clones: GitHub gives them only to a token with push access and keeps 14 days. Without that permission the panel says so; it is not an error.
cfg.h.traffic.repos_per_cycle: How many repositories are read in one cycle; each one at most once a day, with up to five requests.
cfg.h.traffic.keep_days: Older days are deleted from this computer.
ui.traffic.title: Downloads and traffic
ui.traffic.off: The history of downloads and traffic is off.
ui.traffic.none: No repository is chosen. Add them in Settings, tab Downloads and traffic.
ui.traffic.note: Kept on this computer only. Download counts are anonymous, include robots and do not count the "Source code" archives. A dash is a day that was not read.
ui.traffic.summary: Downloads of the release files: {downloads} (read on {day}, UTC)
ui.traffic.status_no_permission: no permission: the token needs push access to this repository
ui.traffic.status_missing: not found, or the token cannot see it
ui.traffic.status_failed: could not be read; it is tried again tomorrow
cli.traffic.help: History of downloads and traffic kept on this computer: status, export (CSV).
cli.traffic.none: No repository is chosen for the history of downloads and traffic.
cli.traffic.line: {repo}: downloads {downloads}, read {day}; releases: {releases}; visits and clones: {traffic}
